testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, filters, project items, inputs, and status indicators MUST include data-testid='...' in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build a stunning dark-themed cyber portfolio with Lucide React / Phosphor icons and Lenis smooth scrolling.
2. Implement Framer Motion scroll reveals for each chapter number and section header.
3. Build the full-screen Hero video using an HTML5 video with layered animated cyber grid particles and cat paw subtle motifs.

4. Ensure all security tools categories (SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, Ticketing, Threat Intel, Network Monitoring, Firewall, Antivirus, eDiscovery/GRC) are displayed in interactive bento cards with filter tabs.
5. Include working interactive features: skill progress cards, project inspection modals, terminal log generator, copyable contact info, and sonner toast on contact form submission.
6. Make sure all buttons and interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
